title: Dow Jones Futures: Stock Market Hits Highs On Iran-Deal Hopes, Nvidia Leads New Buys; ARM Is Earnings Mover
title_zh: 道琼斯期货：伊朗协议希望推动股市触及高位，英伟达引领新买入； ARM 是盈利推动者
summary: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq hit new highs on Iran deal hopes. Nvidia leads new buys with Arm a big earnings mover late.
summary_zh: 由于伊朗协议的希望，标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克指数创下新高。英伟达 (Nvidia) 在新收购中处于领先地位，而 Arm 是后期盈利的重要推动者。

title: Ripple, JPMorgan & Mastercard Pull Off First Tokenized Treasury Deal
title_zh: Ripple、摩根大通和万事达卡完成首笔代币化国债交易
summary: JPMorgan, Ripple, Mastercard, and Ondo settled a tokenized US Treasury redemption across borders in near real time.
summary_zh: 摩根大通、Ripple、万事达卡和 Ondo 近乎实时地跨境结算了代币化的美国国债赎回。

title: The Only Fully Integrated U.S. Rare Earth Producer Has a Deal With Apple and the Pentagon. Here's What Investors Need to Know.
title_zh: 唯一一家完全一体化的美国稀土生产商与苹果和五角大楼达成协议。以下是投资者需要了解的内容。
summary: MP Materials' shares are up more than 168% over the past year. How much more momentum does the stock have?
summary_zh: MP Materials 的股价在过去一年中上涨了 168% 以上。该股还有多少动力？

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures trade flat as investors watch for US-Iran deal
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克期货交易持平，投资者关注美伊协议
summary: Major gauges held steady as markets adjusted to the potential of peace in Iran.
summary_zh: 随着市场根据伊朗和平的潜力进行调整，主要指标保持稳定。

title: Bitcoin Miner Soars On $9.8 Bil Data Center Deal, Morgan Stanley Debuts Crypto Trading
title_zh: 比特币矿商因 98 亿美元数据中心交易而飙升，摩根士丹利首次推出加密货币交易
summary: Bitcoin miner Hut 8 accelerates AI data center growth with $9.8 billion deal. Morgan Stanley debuts crypto trading on E-Trade.
summary_zh: 比特币矿工 Hut 8 通过 98 亿美元的交易加速了人工智能数据中心的发展。摩根士丹利在 E-Trade 上首次推出加密货币交易。
